heading: About the collection
paragraphs: HEN Cheats Collection is an independent project created, curated and maintained by TeeKay87. It brings PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5 game versions, creators, file formats, notes and compatibility-focused metadata together so visitors can quickly find the entry that matches the game they are looking for.

Each catalog entry is organized by Title ID and game version, and source files remain credited to their listed creators. The collection is personally curated and maintained by TeeKay87, with original cheat creators credited on their respective files. Issue and Notes metadata are used to surface important information alongside the available files.
